panel.keyboard-help:
Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
Escape to close
panel.cancelled: Stopped. Close and reopen the panel for a new question.
panel.copy-error: Could not copy the response to the clipboard. Try copying again.
panel.timeout: The operation timed out. Check the keyring and connection, then retry.

credentials.missing-command: secret-tool was not found. Install libsecret and retry.
credentials.unreadable: Could not read the key. Unlock Secret Service and save your key with the secret-tool store command in the README.
credentials.missing: No key was found for the selected provider and endpoint. Store its key in Secret Service using the README instructions.
credentials.invalid: The saved key has an invalid format. Save the key to Secret Service again.
credentials.startup: Could not start key lookup. Check secret-tool and Secret Service.

api.unauthorized: The API key was rejected (401). Check the key in Secret Service.
api.forbidden: Access denied (403). Check your account, model permissions, region and permitted use.
api.rate-limited: Rate or quota limit reached (429). Wait a while and retry.
api.unavailable: The API service is temporarily unavailable. Wait a while and retry.
api.http-error: The API rejected the request (HTTP {status}). Check your model, account and service status.
api.too-long: The response reached the display limit. Partial text was preserved; try a shorter question.
api.connection: The connection failed or was interrupted. Check your Internet and TLS connection, then retry.
api.service-error: The service reported a streaming error. Partial text was preserved; you can retry.
api.incomplete: The response stream ended before completion. Partial text was preserved; you can retry.
api.unreadable: Could not read the response stream. Retry the request.
api.empty: The service returned an empty response. Retry the request.
api.startup: Could not start the request. Check Noctalia network access and offline mode.

config.required: Choose a provider and model in Settings.
config.provider-error: Unknown API provider. Choose OpenCode Go or OpenAI compatible in Settings.
config.endpoint-error: Set a full HTTPS URL ending in /chat/completions in Settings. Credentials in URLs, queries and fragments are not supported.
config.model-error: Enter a valid model ID in Settings (1–256 characters, without control characters).

provider.label: API provider
provider.description: Select the service explicitly. QuickAsk never switches providers automatically. OpenCode Go use must comply with its requirements.

endpoint.label: Chat Completions URL
endpoint.description: Full HTTPS URL ending in /chat/completions. No URL credentials or query parameters. Changing it requires a key stored for that exact URL.

model.label: Model ID
model.description: Exact text model ID supported by your endpoint. It must accept system/user messages and streaming Chat Completions. No model is selected automatically.
